parent_rule: All targets, views and trajectories inherit the parent role. Role reservation is permanent for this experiment family. Old TRAIN is not independent calibration.
initial_generator: fixed last12000 ordinary M4 trained on95 parents, no continued15000 checkpoint

scorer.selection: minimum DEV_SCORE binary cross entropy; earliest tie
scorer.loss: unweighted BCE on actual unfiltered generated candidates

calibration: positive scalar temperature minimizing candidate BCE; only after generator/scorer configuration and checkpoint fixed; report selected-candidate calibration separately
replication_gate: seed0 DEV_SCORE selected validity strictly exceeds both fixed-first and expected-uniform random; Brier below SCORE_TRAIN prevalence predictor; no threshold tuning
mode_distribution: balanced geometric reference clusters, including unknown positives; cluster rule frozen using TRAIN only; not natural occurrence probability
validity: existing tip checker: target3cm, start5mm, unchanged reach events, finite continuous piecewise linear tip path with2cm physical-box margin; not full-arm execution success
oracle_boundary: Geometry labels may produce q targets and evaluation only; neither obstacle truth, target truth, reference paths nor guide/mode IDs enter inference
